sentences.text: Don’t anchor in navigation channels, cable and pipeline areas, or restricted areas, and avoid anchoring where you’ll block other traffic.
At night show your anchor light, and by day a black ball, as Rule thirty requires.
In the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary, anchoring on coral is prohibited, so use the mooring buoys provided at popular reefs.
Avoid anchoring in seagrass where you can, and leave enough room for other boats to swing without hitting you when the wind or current changes.
